metadata.title: Greenland Is Smaller Than ONE African Country 🌍 #shorts
metadata.description:
On most world maps Greenland looks as big as Africa. Drag it to the equator and it shrinks: its real size is smaller than the Democratic Republic of the Congo alone. Africa is about 14 times bigger.

Why? The Mercator projection stretches land near the poles, so Greenland, Canada and Russia look huge while Africa looks small. The mainland United States, China, India and much of Western Europe add up to less than Africa.

Map data: Natural Earth (public domain). Areas computed from the data.

#maps #geography #truesize #mercator #shorts
